narratives.body: LiveScore discusses a reported move for Tresoldi involving AC Milan and Arsenal with a valuation of 60 million as early as January.
narratives.headline: AC Milan transfer interest in Tresoldi

narratives.body: 조선일보 reports that AC Milan collapsed 0-3 in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan received a red card. LiveScore reports that Bournemouth defeated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League after the goalkeeper was sent off. TNT Sports reports that Milan failed to make a substitution following Maignan's red card, a situation described as 'absolutely farcical'.
narratives.headline: AC Milan Europa League defeat and substitution error

narratives.body: LiveScore discusses Pavlovic's assessment that Milan are on the right track despite acknowledging too many mistakes were made.
narratives.headline: Pavlovic on Milan's performance
